t: You Can Now Buy Your Favourite Influencers' Clothes – Here's How
s: September 20, 2018 - So what if you could buy directly from your favourite influencer's wardrobe? The Resolution Store, launching this Friday (21st September), provides just that: access to the sellout, hotly tipped, must-have pieces from some of the biggest influencers. Founded by Anna Sutton and Alicia Waite, who have a collective 20 years' experience in the fashion industry, the resell site will stock clothes sourced from both fashion influencers and insiders – but this isn't just about giving customers a slice of the personal style they see on the 'gram.
